_note: Every number is a frame. Shared by PovShort.tsx and scripts/build-pov-audio.py. Music: Also sprach Zarathustra (Dudamel, Berliner Philharmoniker). Part A plays from 33.0 s, so its six timpani hits (36.36 37.08 37.74 38.48 38.88 39.30 s) land on the pickaxe strikes at frames 101 122 142 164 176 189 and the full-orchestra hit (39.98 s) on frame 209, where the last block breaks.
